name: anofox-visualization
description: Charts and dashboards from SQL with the anofox_visualization DuckDB extension — SQL to SVG (anofox_render and the column chart macros), interactive ::ROLE dashboards (layout, KPIs, tables, inputs, cross-filter, dashboard --check lint and design rules), the anofox_plot_* contract macros for anofox-statistics and anofox-forecast output (coefficients, residual diagnostics, predictions and forecasts, ROC / survival / CV curves, post-hoc tests), and locked, read-only serving of dashboards.
